title: Hook plan
description: D107 (documentary plan, slice 6a) — the moments of the hook put on screen in the 'headlines' hook mode, each already checked against its beat and mapped to a catalog component. Written by the hook_plan stage; compile_plan merges them into the overlay selection for beats that carry no graphic of their own.

says.description: 1-3 words copied from the beat: where the moment lands

quote.description: phrase form: the verbatim span the compiler adds to the beat as a quote anchor

place.description: satellite form (D110): the place name the compiler adds to the beat as a place anchor, landing on `says`

dropped.description: moments the model proposed that broke a rule, with the rule — for the log
